_doc: Ground truth for the 56 single-turn English queries in eval/multilingual/dataset/queries_en.jsonl. Hand-labelled against the intent taxonomy in backend/services/llm_service.py::_EXTRACT_SYSTEM_PROMPT. grade=strict is scored; grade=ambiguous has more than one defensible label; grade=gap has NO valid label because the taxonomy has no intent for it. Only strict is counted in accuracy -- the rest are reported for manual review rather than scored against an invented answer.

st08.entity_note: 'submission ID 1' is not a report name; report_name not graded

sc05.entity_note: 'the depositor report' is a prose name; report_name not graded

sc06.why: 'remind me to generate X 2 days before due date' is a reminder, defensibly schedule_report or generate_instance

cp04.why: 'compare my department with report department' mixes a compare verb with a db_* domain noun; the prompt's rule 1 and rule 2 disagree

dq03.why: 'who works in Finance' is defensibly db_list_users or db_department_info

dq05.query_type_note: 'active' or 'count' both defensible; query_type not graded

dq07.why: last-login is audit data, not profile; taxonomy has no audit intent

dq10.why: returns listing has no intent in the taxonomy

dq11.why: department-to-return permission mapping spans two intents

dq14.why: return due dates have no intent in the taxonomy
